crossRefs.note: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
The greeting of me, Paul, with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter: this is how I write.
yet for love’s sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before Yahweh’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his…
Yahweh said to Satan, “Yahweh rebuke you, Satan! Yes, Yahweh who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning…
Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you, and was hindered so far, that I…
Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from those who desire an occasion, that in which they boast…
Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into…
The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole…

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
translations.bsb: For we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan obstructed us.
translations.kjv: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
translations.asv: because we would fain have come unto you, I Paul once and again; and Satan hindered us.
